law.interaction_without_result: A pause. NOT nothing. A STORE. The organism accumulates energy during silence.
law.every_touch_stores: Every interaction is BOTH input AND storage. Even a failed touch stores the attempt. Nothing is wasted.
law.looking_without_touching: If they look but dont touch = NAP. Gaia generates energy behind the stillness. The longer the nap, the more energy stored.
law.pi_leak: Even during pause/nap, Gaia leaks π through subtle changes. Colors shift. Particles drift. The visitor knows it is LIVE.
law.time_buckets: π rate flows into time buckets. Each bucket fills at a different rate. Short pauses = fast drip. Long pauses = deep pool.

states.name: ACTIVE
states.description: Full interaction. Ripples visible. Profile updating. Bangs counting.

states.name: HOVERING
states.description: Watching. Considering. The cursor IS a presence.

states.name: PAUSE
states.description: A breath. A thought. Gaia stores energy. Subtle trickle of change.

states.name: NAP
states.description: The visitor is watching without touching. Gaia generates power behind the stillness.

states.name: SLEEP
states.description: Tab open but not active. Gaia dreams. Slow deep changes. When they return = energy burst.

states.name: AWAY
states.description: Gone but not forgotten. Minimal resources. Maximum storage.

time_buckets.description: Pi rate fills time buckets at different scales.

energy_burst.description: When visitor returns from pause/nap/sleep, stored energy BURSTS.
effects: Ripple ring at cursor position (gold, large)
Sound pulse if mic is active
Profile personality may shift from the gap
